persona.name: Dana Ruiz, 38
persona.line: Works at a school, two kids, moved last year and hasn’t found a regular doctor yet. Tonight her son twisted his ankle at practice.
wants: To be seen today without an emergency room bill
To leave with a family doctor, not just a receipt
worries: Long waits she can’t plan around
A bill she didn’t see coming
Repeating her history to a new face every time
